source: Acme Robotics said on Tuesday that its warehouse picker, Model R2, now handles 1,200 items an hour, up from 800 last year. Chief engineer Priya Nair said the gain came from a new suction gripper and from re-planning routes every 30 seconds instead of every 5 minutes. The company tested the change in its Leeds warehouse for 6 weeks. Nair conceded that the gripper still fails on shrink-wrapped goods, about 4% of stock. Pricing stays at $2,500 a month per robot, and customers in Germany get the update in March.
